name: Traccar
tagline: Open-source GPS tracking server with REST API for devices, positions, and geofences
description: Traccar is an open-source GPS tracking platform with REST endpoints for devices, positions, geofences, users, groups, and reports, plus /api/socket WebSocket live updates. REST clients can use HTTP Basic authentication, Bearer account tokens, or session cookies. Create a password session by POSTing form-encoded email and password to /api/session, or a token session with GET /api/session?token=USER_TOKEN. It can be self-hosted or used through Traccar's hosted subscriptions.

auth.details: Session cookie after HTTP Basic Auth login to /api/session, or Authorization: Bearer <token> when tokens are enabled; self-hosted or Traccar Cloud account.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Self-hosting is free/open source with no default software limits. Public demo servers are free for testing with no feature or device-count limits, but lack preconfigured reverse geocoding/email and guarantee neither QoS nor full history. Hosted subscriptions start at $9.95/month.
pricing.paid_plans: Traccar Cloud paid tiers available; self-host is free

use_cases: list GPS devices registered on a Traccar server
get latest position for a tracked device
create or update a geofence for a device group
fetch historical positions or trip reports for a device
register a new tracker by uniqueId
